title: Edge Zero-Trust Quickstart: Illustration set and guided installer UI
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and deliver a cohesive illustration set and guided installer UI for Private/VPC onboarding focusing on zero-trust edge deployments. Deliverables include a modular network-flow diagram library, step-by-step installer screens (web and CLI companion), upgrade/rollback micro-interactions, and developer-ready redlines for Console and on-prem installer docs.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file with componentized illustration library and 6 installer flows (new install, join existing VPC, offline bootstrap, upgrade, rollback, network troubleshoot)
Exported SVG and PNG assets sized for Console UI, docs, and marketing (2x and 3x variants)
Handoff-ready specs: spacing tokens, color tokens, animation timings, accessibility contrast checks
Annotated redlines and a Confluence guide for engineers with example markup and CSS token mappings
Sign-off from PM (Marcus Li) and Eng lead (Devon Park) on visuals and interaction patterns
assets_needed: Illustration library: topology primitives (edge node, gateway, load balancer, private link, HSM)
Installer UI screens: 12 artboards including mobile/responsive variants
Micro-animation spec: Lottie/json or exported GIFs for upgrade progress and rollback
CLI companion screenshots and annotated terminal copy
High-contrast color palette and accessible icon variants
design_notes: Prefer an abstracted topology style (flat icons + layered depth) to avoid implying specific hardware brands
Topology diagrams should support incremental reveal: start with 'control plane' then expand to 'data plane' and 'peers'
Installer screens use progressive disclosure: surface only required fields by default and advanced toggles for KMS/HSM and network policies
Animations constrained to 150-250ms per step for perceived speed; long-running ops get continuous subtle progress loop
Provide offline-first imagery for air-gapped installs: emphasize USB/airgap/ops console flows
Ensure color tokens map to design system for light/dark Console themes and maintain 4.5:1 contrast for key text
decisions: Use stepper-style installer rather than a single-page wizard to make resumability clearer
Topology diagrams will be modular SVGs that can be composed in Console based on customer-configured components
Rollback animation will show safe-state fallback to 'last-known-good' with explicit time-to-restore messaging
Avoid detailed network diagrams in marketing assets; include simplified variants for docs and detailed ones behind a toggle in Console
open_questions: Do we need localized illustrations for APAC customers or rely on neutral iconography?
Should the installer surface telemetry opt-in during setup or defer to post-install preferences?
What is the final list of supported HSM/KMS integrations for the first release?
How will Console ingest and render the modular SVGs — inline or via CDN sprites?
